entities.summary: The most devastating conflict in human history (1939-1945), involving 61 countries, 1.7 billion people, and resulting in 70-85 million deaths including the Holocaust. The war destroyed European colonial empires, created the United Nations and Cold War bipolar order, generated nuclear weapons, and established the United States as a superpower — reshaping every aspect of the modern world.
